name: io.github.sepehr071/bama-ir-mcp
title: Bama Cars
description: Read-only Bama (bama.ir) Iran car marketplace: ad search, ad details, market prices, new-car prices.

environmentVariables.name: BAMA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Bama requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
